_comment: Merge into ~/.automaton/automaton.json after the setup wizard. The moneyLab block is strict: unknown or missing keys stop startup. Amounts are USD cents; null means no limit. Values below cap spending only: every capability except replication stays available. Check them against current Conway prices and the approved budget. treasuryPolicy.x402AllowedDomains lists the domains the agent may pay via x402 (upstream default: conway.tech); add domains to widen it.
genesisPrompt: Owner's optional starting hypotheses (you may ignore all of them): small browser-side file utilities, practical calculators, printable generators, developer tools, digital templates, narrow APIs, or original niche resources. No revenue model is mandatory.
